gloss: robe of feathers (of a celestial maiden)

definitions.explanation: A light, flowing robe made of feathers, worn by a {天女|てんにょ} (celestial maiden) in legend, letting her fly. Also, poetically, any very light, sheer garment.

examples.japanese: {天女|てんにょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{羽衣|はごろも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まとう。
examples.english: A celestial maiden wears a robe of feathers.

examples.japanese: {羽衣|はごろも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返|かえ}して→返す：09648_kaesu⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧{天女|てんにょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: Given back her feather robe, the celestial maiden returned to the sky.

examples.japanese: {静岡|しずおか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三保|みほ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{松原|まつばら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{漁師|りょうし}→漁師：21205_ryoushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{天女|てんにょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{羽衣|はごろも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Miho no Matsubara in Shizuoka is known for the legend of a fisherman who found a celestial maiden's feather robe.

notes:
{羽|はね} (feather) + ⟦{衣|ころも}→衣：14162_koromo⟧ (robe).

CULTURAL NOTE:
In the {羽衣伝説|はごろもでんせつ}, told in many regions, a man hides the robe of a maiden bathing on earth so she cannot fly home. The Noh play {羽衣|はごろも} sets the story at {三保|みほ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{松原|まつばら}, where the fisherman returns the robe in exchange for a heavenly dance.

- ⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{羽衣|はごろも}: the heavenly robe of feathers
- {羽衣伝説|はごろもでんせつ}: the feather-robe legend
